title: CLO 2025.1 - CLO-SET
description: CLO 2025.1 new version fully upgraded to further enhance your work efficiency! In the new version, we have optimized CLO-SET: the brand-new texture configurator and content analysis features help you accelerate your workflow even more.
transcript:
This video introduces the new update of Closet.  
We have introduced a new function, the sticker editor, to enhance your design capabilities.  
As in Closet, users can now edit stickers on 3D clothing within Closet.  
First, enter the content page.  
On the right side, click the button to access the new tool.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the edit sticker tool.  
Then click the sticker.  
The sticker will display the shape controller around it.  
We can use the shape controller to adjust the sticker.  
First, drag the triangle around the controller.  
You can adjust the width and length according to the picture’s proportions.  
Another way is as follows.  
You can rotate your image or layer.  
Drag the outer circle around the controller to rotate the picture.  
Press the center key, and shift key for the controller.  
You can now adjust the position.  
Under the material option on the right, select the basic parameters.  
Click to replace the icon.  
Select the sticker from the folder.  
Click to open.  
Now the sticker has been replaced with a new icon.  
You can also adjust its position, proportion, angle, etc.  
Through the sticker configuration tool,  
even those who do not have CLO software can participate in the design and development.  
Now let’s introduce another new function, content analysis.  
Through this function,  
you can actually check the progress and content activity analysis of the work process.  
First,  
go to the content page.  
Click on the content analysis button in the upper right corner,  
then you can enter the content analysis page.  
The work process analysis provides the progress of the work process  
and the draft of the development cycle.  
The total delivery cycle in the upper right corner shows the number of days passed since the content was created.  
The time axis in the middle shows the delivery cycle between each workflow state.  
This is the time axis for all workflows.  
When the mouse hovers over a specific workflow,  
it shows the number of activities in each status.  
You can see the upload, broadcast, communication, and download of its versions.  
Below the time axis,  
the activity analysis provides detailed activity data.  
In the upper right corner, you can switch the display between bubble chart or pile chart.  
You can adjust the display area size by scrolling.  
Through the activity analysis table, you can identify the fundamental reasons for extending the delivery period.  
We can quickly find out which activities are the most active and support our strategic decisions.

chunks.content: ## CLO 2025.1 Update Overview This section introduces the latest CLO 2025.1 update, focusing on new features such as the Sticker Editor and Content Analysis tools designed to enhance design capabilities and workflow monitoring within CLO-SET. --- ## Sticker Editor in CLO-SET This section explains the new Sticker Editor feature, enabling users to edit stickers directly on 3D clothing models within CLO. It details how to access and manipulate stickers, covering shape adjustment, rotation, and replacement. ### Accessing the Sticker Editor - Navigate to the content page in CLO-SET. - On the right side, click the button to open the new tool. - In the 3D toolbar, select the **Edit Sticker** tool. ### Editing Stickers - Click on the sticker to display the shape controller around it. - Use the triangle handles on the controller to adjust the sticker’s width and length, maintaining the picture’s proportions. - Rotate the sticker by dragging the outer circle of the controller. - Press the center and Shift keys while dragging to adjust the sticker’s position precisely. ### Replacing Stickers - Under the **Material** options on the right, select the basic parameters. - Click the replace icon to select a new sticker from the folder. - Open the chosen sticker to replace the existing one. - Adjust position, proportion, and angle as needed. ### Collaborative Design Benefits The sticker configuration tool allows users without CLO software to participate in design and development processes, facilitating broader collaboration. --- ## Content Analysis Tool This section describes the Content Analysis feature, which provides detailed insights into work progress and activity during the development cycle, helping teams monitor timelines and identify workflow bottlenecks. ### Accessing Content Analysis - Navigate to the content page. - Click the **Content Analysis** button in the upper right corner to open the analysis page. ### Work Process Analysis - Displays the progress of the work process and development draft cycle. - The **Total Delivery Cycle** indicator (top right) shows the number of days since content creation. - The **Time Axis** visualizes the delivery cycle between each workflow state for all workflows. - Hovering over a specific workflow reveals the number of activities in each status, such as upload, broadcast, communication, and download events. ### Activity Analysis - Located below the time axis, this section provides detailed data on workflow activities. - Users can toggle the display between a **Bubble Chart** and a **Pile Chart**. - The display area size is adjustable via scrolling. - The activity analysis table helps identify causes for delivery delays by showing the most active tasks and supporting strategic decision-making. --- This structured update enhances CLO-SET’s usability by improving design precision through the Sticker Editor and enabling data-driven workflow management with Content Analysis.
